title: 10 Biggest GTA 6 Questions the Previews Haven't Answered Yet
description: Polygon highlights the biggest unanswered questions following Rockstar's Netflix Grand Theft Auto 6 extended look, focusing on cast and GTA Online.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Big Questions Left After the GTA 6 Extended Look

As the gaming community continues to dissect every piece of media surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, new discussions have emerged regarding what we still don't know. Following the extended look at Grand Theft Auto 6 via Netflix, major outlets like Polygon have pointed out that despite the exciting footage, several major questions remain completely unanswered.

## Who Is Actually in the Cast?

One of the most prominent mysteries surrounding GTA 6 involves its cast. While trailers and promotional materials have introduced us to the main characters, the full lineup of voice and performance capture actors has not been fully detailed. Fans are left wondering about the identities of the actors behind the protagonists and what other notable talent might be featured in the game's expansive world.

## What Is Happening with GTA Online?

Another massive question mark hangs over the future of GTA Online. Given the monumental and enduring success of the current online mode from GTA 5, players are eager to learn how the multiplayer experience will transition into the era of GTA 6. Will it be a brand-new standalone experience, a complete overhaul, or something else entirely? Recent previews have left this crucial topic largely unaddressed.

## The Strategy Behind the Silence

Rockstar Games has always favored a measured and calculated approach to its marketing campaigns. By releasing carefully curated extended looks rather than spilling all the details at once, the studio successfully keeps anticipation at an all-time high. While fans crave definitive answers about the cast, gameplay systems, and online infrastructure, the mystery itself has become part of the pre-release ritual.

## Editor's Take

It is classic Rockstar fashion to give us just enough to marvel at the technical achievements while keeping the most critical details under wraps. While the unanswered questions can be frustrating for eager fans, this strategic silence ultimately fuels the speculation engine that keeps the entire gaming community engaged as we wait for more official updates.
